text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hawawa, Machan's flawless skin has blemishes on it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If this goes on, Machan will become
a mascot with bumpy, breakout skin.
This is an absolute emergency."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Since Curren Chan was born lovely,
I want everyone to remember me looking lovely."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Mom knows any good medicine. I should call and ask her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she was going to be a mascot, she wanted to be in ideal form.
Aston Machan was troubled by her skin breakouts.
